Messages.Author: Gwen Morse
Messages.Body:
Say my vamp (Marianna Gilbert) has the retainer ghoul (ghoul retainer?
ghoul bodyguard?) that can use a weapon, but, is in close range combat
with an opponent who has played Immortal Grapple.

Now, say Marianna had equipped with a gun earlier in the game. While
the potence/grapple machine is beating the stuffing out of her, can
her ghoul still use the gun? Or, any weapon at that rate?

Gwen Morse

>
> Now, say Marianna had equipped with a gun earlier in the game. While
> the potence/grapple machine is beating the stuffing out of her, can

You may want to wait for LSJ to "officialize" this, but I'm pretty sure
that the Ghoul Retainer can only use weapons that the vampire could
ordinarily use (and just didn't). So, if you have two guns, you can
shoot one while the ghoul shoots the other. But, under Immortal
Grapple, you can't shoot the gun, so neither can your little friend. :)

Messages.Author: Robert Goudie
Messages.Body:
Gwen Morse wrote:

> Say my vamp (Marianna Gilbert) has the retainer ghoul (ghoul retainer?
> ghoul bodyguard?) that can use a weapon, but, is in close range combat
> with an opponent who has played Immortal Grapple.

The Ghoul Retainer can use a weapon if one exists, otherwise it does 1
damage to the oppossing minion during strike resolution. The IG is
irrelevant because its text doesn't prohibit retainers from using weapons.

> Now, say Marianna had equipped with a gun earlier in the game. While
> the potence/grapple machine is beating the stuffing out of her, can
> her ghoul still use the gun? Or, any weapon at that rate?

The ghoul can use the gun or any other weapon. The only exception would
be if Marianna used the gun for a manuever but a manuever back to close
was played followed by an IG. In this case Marianna is committed to using
the gun (even though IG prohibits her from using it for a strike) and the
Ghoul can't use it.

-Robert

Nah - card text doesn't say anything about the weapon being able to be
used by the Ghoul's employer (just that it is not being used by the
employer). This may be counterintuitive, but we know what that's worth,
right? :-)

The Ghoul is "using" the weapon (but not striking with it), so some cards
(like Sawed Off Shotgun) which can only be "used" once per combat work
intuitively even when a Ghoul gets in the picture. But other times, well...
